request.text: Seamless soft protective harmonics on A4 E5 B4, slowly overlapping bell-glass tones and a fine airy watery halo. Tender, watchful, reassuring, meditative. No alarm, tension rise, melody, beat, ticking, bass impact, choir or voices. Restrained treble, continuous quiet texture, no beginning or ending. No voices, harsh transients or distortion. Quiet microscopic pond-game sound design.
